description:
Build a harmonious color palette from one base color (complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary, tetradic, square, monochromatic or tints and shades). Returns each color as HEX, RGB, HSL and OKLCH with WCAG contrast against white and black, an 11-step 50-950 scale of the base, and ready-to-paste CSS variables and Tailwind config. Same maths as https://redbison.dev/color-palette-generator.

Returns: JSON { base, rule, wheel, colors[] { role, hex, rgb, hsl, oklch, contrastOnWhite, contrastOnBlack, bestTextColor, wcagNormalText }, scale { '50'..'950': hex }, baseScaleStep, css, tailwindV3, tailwindV4 }.
Example input: {"base":"#3b82f6","rule":"triadic","wheel":"rgb","name":"brand"}
On error, includes hint: Pass the base color as hex like #3b82f6 (rgb(), hsl(), oklch() and CSS names also work). rule must be one of complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary, tetradic, square, monochromatic, shades.

base.description: Base color as hex (#3b82f6), rgb(59 130 246), hsl(217 91% 60%), oklch(62% 0.19 260) or a CSS color name.

name.description: Name used in the CSS and Tailwind exports, e.g. 'brand'. Default 'brand'.

wheel.description: Color wheel for hue rotation: 'rgb' (screen/HSL wheel, default), 'ryb' (approximate painter's wheel, red opposite green) or 'oklch' (perceptual, keeps lightness).

name: color_palette
title: Color palette generator
